newsitem.title: USA: Parker Drilling files for $125 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Parker Drilling files for $125 mln in notes.

text.p: Parker Drilling Co filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration to sell up to $125 million in convertible subordinated notes due 2004.
The company has granted the underwriters an overallotment option to purchase up to $18,750,000 in additional notes.
The joint lead managers are Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Jefferies & Co Inc. Underwriters also include Bear, Stearns & Co Inc and Prudential Securities Inc.

Net proceeds will be used to finance a portion of the consideration payable in the Hercules acquisition. In the event the acquisition does not close, the proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
In May, Parker signed definitive agreements to acquire Hercules Offshore Corp, a Houston-based offshore drilling contractor, and Hercules Rig Corp for $195 million.

Parker, based in Tulsa, Olka., is a worldwide provider of contract drilling and drilling related services, operating in the shallow coastal waters of the Gulf of Mexico and Nigeria and in international and additional domestic land oil and gas producing regions.
